statement: The function returns a result r that is the maximum possible sum of selected elements of nums with the constraint that the selected sum is divisible by 3. Formally, using subsets of indices: r is divisible by 3; there exists a subset I of {0,...,len(nums)-1} with Σ_{i∈I} nums[i] = r; and for every subset J of {0,...,len(nums)-1} with Σ_{j∈J} nums[j] divisible by 3, Σ_{j∈J} nums[j] <= r. The empty subset is allowed, so the value 0 is always available.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= Σ_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is divisible by 3 (there exists an integer k with r = 3*k).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exists a subset I of {0,...,len(nums)-1} such that Σ_{i∈I} nums[i] = r. The empty subset is allowed.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every subset J of {0,...,len(nums)-1} whose sum Σ_{j∈J} nums[j] is divisible by 3, we have Σ_{j∈J} nums[j] <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if there is no nonempty subset I of {0,...,len(nums)-1} whose sum Σ_{i∈I} nums[i] is divisible by 3.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if Σ_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i] is divisible by 3, then r = Σ_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Let T = Σ_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i], and let d be the integer in {0,1,2} such that T is congruent to d modulo 3. Let m be the minimum value of Σ_{i∈R} nums[i] over all subsets R of {0,...,len(nums)-1} for which Σ_{i∈R} nums[i] is congruent to d modulo 3; when d=0 the empty subset is allowed and gives m=0. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = T - m.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= Σ_{i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] is divisible by 3} nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if T = Σ_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i] is not divisible by 3, then r < T.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if len(nums) = 1, then r = nums[0] when nums[0] is divisible by 3, and r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every subset I of {0,...,len(nums)-1} with Σ_{i∈I} nums[i] = r and for every index j with 0 <= j < len(nums) such that nums[j] is divisible by 3, we have j ∈ I.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every subset I of {0,...,len(nums)-1} with Σ_{i∈I} nums[i] = r, there is no nonempty subset J of the complement {0,...,len(nums)-1} \ I such that Σ_{j∈J} nums[j] is divisible by 3.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: For every permutation p of {0,...,len(nums)-1}, let nums' be the slice of length len(nums) with nums'[i] = nums[p(i)] for all i. Whenever the function returns r on nums and r' on nums', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 40000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000.
